question: All human beings have ________ pairs of chromosomes in the nuclei of their cells.
solution:
The correct answer is __**23**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chromosomes**:-

 
 
• Chromosomes are thread-like structures located inside the nucleus of animal and plant cells.
 
• **Each chromosome is made of protein and a single molecule of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA). **
 
• DNA contains the genetic information that makes each living thing unique.
 
• **Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes, for a total of 46 chromosomes in each cell. (Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
• The first 22 pairs are called autosomes, and they look the same in both males and females.
 
• The 23rd pair is the sex chromosomes, which determine a person's sex. Females have two X chromosomes, while males have one X and one Y chromosome.
